name: AR Space
description: Planets in 3D floating around you on the camera: Earth with clouds and its Moon, Jupiter, Saturn with rings, a space station and a UFO. Tap to learn, snap AR photos.
prompt: An augmented reality space scene: on top of the camera, 3D planets float around you and stay in place as you move the phone, Earth with clouds and its Moon, Jupiter, Saturn with rings, Mars, a space station, an asteroid belt and a UFO, with facts when you tap them and AR photos saved to the gallery.
author: gonzaroman
